title: Petal Paddle
tagline: Drift through golden ripples and gather floating blossoms.
how_to_play: Steer your duckling around the pond to collect glowing lotus blossoms for points while steering clear of drifting spiky seed pods to protect your three lives.

music.lyrics:
[Intro]
Mmm, golden ripples...
[Verse]
Amber light upon the blue,
Gentle currents carry you.
Floating petals, soft and bright,
Glowing in the evening light.
[Chorus]
Paddle slow and take your time,
Where the quiet waters shine.
Pocket pond of pastel gold,
Peaceful stories to unfold.
[Outro]
Sun dips low, the breeze is still,
Sweetest dreams upon the hill.

voice_line: Welcome to the pond, little friend. Take a deep breath and enjoy the golden hour.
